skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand economic principles and theories in the context of investment and management.
Apply project management principles to real-world investment scenarios.
Conduct independent research and analyze data to solve investment-related problems.
Identify and solve complex investment issues using logical reasoning and analytical skills.
Effectively communicate research findings and solutions through presentations and reports.
Work effectively in teams and independently to complete research tasks.
Develop the ability to learn independently and continuously improve professional knowledge.
Adhere to professional ethics and regulations in the workplace.
Produce well-structured and professional reports based on research findings.
Deliver clear and engaging presentations on research topics.
